description.value: The Bloedel Floral Conservatory is a distinctive triodetic dome perched at the summit of Queen Elizabeth Park in Vancouver, sheltering hundreds of free-flying exotic birds and a rich collection of tropical and subtropical plants year-round. Operated by the City of Vancouver through the Vancouver Botanical Gardens Association, it shares ticketing and membership benefits with the nearby VanDusen Botanical Garden. Cyclists exploring central Vancouver's greenways will find it a memorable cultural stop in one of the city's most scenic parks.
